excerpt.zh:
当£science_ship£科研船已经准备探索星系时，所需要做的只有取消暂停了。只需要简单地按下空格键£space£或在顶部栏点击以下按钮即可：

                                    £pause_button£
excerpt.en:
With a £science_ship£ Science Ship standing by to explore the galaxy, all that is left is to unpause. To do this, simply press the Space Bar £space£ or select the following icon in the top bar:

                                    £pause_button£
